usage: music-tagger mb discid [-h] [--toc TOC] [-o OUT] [discid]

Look up releases by disc ID or TOC offsets.

positional arguments:
  discid         MusicBrainz disc ID.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --toc TOC      TOC string for fuzzy lookup (from `toc` command).
  -o, --out OUT  Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
